## Review checklist
- [ ] All template sections are complete — no unfilled placeholder text remains
- [ ] No real client, company, person, or proprietary system names appear in the document
- [ ] Every row in the Open Questions table has a "Who can answer" and "Needed by" value
- [ ] Metadata `status` field is correct:
  - `draft` — first submission, not yet reviewed
  - `under-review` — PR is open and stakeholders are resolving questions
  - `committed` — all open questions resolved; ready to merge and advance to the next stage
- [ ] **If merging as `committed`:** Open Questions table has no rows with Status = Open
